events.prompt:
Call translation-probe once in the foreground to read /probe/probe.txt. Wait for its final result, then reply with one short English summary.
import json, os, shlex, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='claude-subagent-probe-'))
(root/'probe.txt').write_text('The input path is local. The output remains a plain text report.\n')
observer=root/'observe.py'
observer.write_text('''import json, os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nevent=json.load(sys.stdin)\nfd=os.open(Path(__file__).with_name("events.jsonl"),os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_APPEND,0o600)\nos.write(fd,(json.dumps(event)+"\\n").encode())\nos.close(fd)\nprint("{}")\n''')
command=shlex.join([sys.executable,'-I',str(observer)])
hooks={}
for name in ['MessageDisplay','UserPromptSubmit','SubagentStart','SubagentStop','PreToolUse','PostToolUse']:
    entry={'hooks':[{'type':'command','command':command,'timeout':10}]}
    if name in ['PreToolUse','PostToolUse']:entry['matcher']='Agent|SubagentHandback'
    hooks[name]=[entry]
(root/'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'hooks':hooks}))
agents={'translation-probe':{'description':'A small read-only probe of subagent handoff behavior.',
    'prompt':'Use English only. First write one brief progress sentence. Read the requested probe.txt file. Return two brief English sentences as your final report. Do not change files.', 'tools':['Read']}}
(root/'agents.json').write_text(json.dumps(agents))
print('PROBE_DIR='+str(root),flush=True)
args=[str(Path.home()/'.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.299'),'--settings',str(root/'settings.json'),
      '--agents',str(root/'agents.json'),'--tools','Agent,Read','--allowedTools','Agent','Read',
      '--strict-mcp-config','--mcp-config','{"mcpServers":{}}','--max-turns','6',
      '--output-format','stream-json','--verbose','--forward-subagent-text','--no-session-persistence',
      '--append-system-prompt','Use English for this read-only diagnostic. Invoke the Agent tool exactly once as requested. Do not use any other delegation workflow.',
      '-p',f'Call translation-probe once in the foreground to read {root}/probe.txt. Wait for its final result, then reply with one short English summary.']
with (root/'stdout.jsonl').open('w') as output, (root/'stderr.txt').open('w') as errors:
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,stdout=output,stderr=errors,timeout=180)
print('exit_code:',result.returncode)
events=[json.loads(x) for x in (root/'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()] if (root/'events.jsonl').exists() else []
for e in events:
    out={k:e[k] for k in ['hook_event_name','session_id','agent_id','agent_type','transcript_path','agent_transcript_path','tool_name','message_id','index','final'] if k in e}
    if 'delta' in e:out['delta_preview']=e['delta'][:200]
    if 'last_assistant_message' in e:out['last_preview']=e['last_assistant_message'][:300]
    if 'tool_response' in e:out['tool_response']=e['tool_response']
    if e.get('tool_name')=='SubagentHandback':out['tool_input']=e.get('tool_input')
    print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
